definitions: One of a pair of poles with footrests, enabling someone to walk elevated above the ground.
A long, slender pole or post used to support a structure above the ground or water.
Any of several long-legged shorebirds of the genera Himantopus and Cladorhynchus, having a slender body, long bill, and very long pink legs.
examples: He walked on stilts in the parade.
The house was built on stilts to protect it from floods.
We saw a black-necked stilt at the marsh.
